ladder.label: BOTTOMING
ladder.why: New daily cycle, day 11: swing low in, price back above the 10-day average, daily momentum positive — but the weekly timeframe hasn't turned yet, so conviction is partial. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Either wait for the weekly to turn, or size half until it does.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 15 · daily cycle day 11).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): bottoming. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)

entry.text: Setup almost complete — likely buy trigger in ~1–3 trading days if it closes back above its 10-day average.

cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 新的日线周期，第 11 天：摆动低点已现，价格重新站上 10 日均线，日线动量为正——但周线周期尚未转向，因此信心仅为部分。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 可等待周线转向，或在其转向前先建半仓。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 15 周 · 日线周期第 11 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
